5. [PREFERENCE] The user is interested in "The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society" and has heard great things about it.
6. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided historical context and inspiration for "The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society":
   - Set on the island of Guernsey during WWII, occupied by German forces from 1940 to 1945.
   - The occupation led to food shortages, curfews, and restrictions for islanders.
   - Mary Ann Shaffer was inspired to write the novel after visiting Guernsey in 1980 and learning about the islanders' resilience and a book club formed during the occupation.
   - The novel is set in 1946 and follows Juliet Ashton, a writer who connects with the islanders through letters.
   - Shaffer passed away in 2008; her niece, Annie Barrows, helped complete the editing process.
7. [PREFERENCE] The user is looking forward to reading "The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society."
8. [EVENT] The user is thinking about starting a book club with friends.
9. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips on starting a book club:
   - Define the purpose and scope of the club.
   - Choose a format (in-person, online, frequency).
   - Select a core group of members (5-10).
   - Pick a name and create an identity.
   - Decide on a book selection process.
   - Establish a discussion format.
   - Set expectations for participation.
   - Plan for food and drink.
   - Create a schedule for meetings.
   - Be flexible and
